title: The hanging rose-gardens,
paragraphs: Until they sink, Sink down, pale, down to night: So sank I once From my delusion of truth, From my daytime longings, Weary of day, sick with light, Sank downwards, down to evening, down to shadows: Scorched and thirsty With one truth: Do you remember, do you, hot heart, How you thirsted then?
That I am banished From all truth, Only a fool!
